description: A single knowledge node in a student's public second brain. Not tied to a course or session — though it may optionally reference one via academicRef. Supports markdown (default), plaintext, LaTeX, or HTML. Content blob stored on the Ring; this PDS record holds metadata only. Versioned like notes — each edit creates a new record linked to its parent.

title.description: Short title of the node. Shown in graph views and link previews.

format.description: Content format. Markdown is the default for brain nodes.

latex.description: LaTeX source. Appropriate for technical/academic nodes.

html.description: HTML. Use sparingly — markdown is preferred.

ringRef.description: Reference to the content blob on the Ring.

tags.description: Free-form tags for organisation and discovery (e.g. 'physics', 'book-notes', 'idea', 'project'). These form the student's personal Map of Content.

academicRef.description: Optional AT URI of a related app.changala.session or app.changala.course record. When set, this node bridges the brain and academic layers — it appears in both the brain graph and the academic session view.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number. Starts at 1.

parentNode.description: AT URI of the previous version of this node. Null for the initial version.

summary.description: Short description shown in graph tooltips and link previews (max 512 chars).
